channel.title: Spatial Omics Radar
channel.description: New technologies, tools, AI models and benchmarks across spatial omics

item.title: Weekly update · 23 new entries
item.description:
VirTues, a foundation model for multiplex spatial proteomics, lands in Nature and is this week's clear standout given the venue. TissueFormer's 17M-pair histology-to-expression foundation model is worth a look too, as foundation models are the week's dominant thread. Otherwise heavy on transcriptomics methods, with only a scattering of proteomics/metabolomics work (10X ExMSI, UNIPRO) for cross-modality coverage.
